items.question: What kind of fear arises for enemies when the navel region is targeted?
premises: The navel region is specified as the site of effect.
Enemies are identified as those affected.
The resulting condition is described as all-encompassing fear.
items.inference: Targeting the navel region produces an all-encompassing fear in enemies.
items.plain_english: But in the navel region, an all-encompassing fear may arise for enemies.
